title: OwnerDecision
description: One authoritative, auditable record of an owner decision -- architectural, research, modeling, implementation, replay, shadow, paper, production, or future live-trading. OwnerDecision records are authoritative source data (like a TraderRecord or StrategyRule), not generated graph artifacts: they live under docs/trader-intelligence/graph/decisions/ and are hand-authored, one file per decision, never edited after creation (a revised decision supersedes an earlier one via supersedesDecisionId; the earlier record is never edited or deleted). Owner approval must be auditable this way and must never be represented only as prose in a chat transcript.

decisionId.description: Format: DECISION|MOGO|{YYYYMMDD}|{seq}. 'MOGO' is a fixed scope segment -- this repository has one owner today; the segment exists so the id format does not need to change if that ever stops being true.

affectedEntityIds.description: IDs of the entities (traders, strategy families, rules, questions, etc.) this decision concerns.

question.description: The decision actually being made, stated plainly.

approvalScope.description: The highest scope this decision actually authorizes. Independent of, but must stay consistent with, the specific *Authorization booleans below.
